issue.title: [HFO-04] Generate subject-scoped occurrences without duplicate or rewritten history
issue.description:
The current unique key uses template revision and cannot separate multiple assets or resident/employee subjects.

**Scope**
Use stable activity + site + subject + period/shift/source event as occurrence identity. Add concurrent generation, catch-up, manual unscheduled work linkage and explicit retirement/cancellation reconciliation.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] Two assets of the same type receive distinct occurrences; concurrent scheduler runs generate one per intended subject/period.
- [ ] Publishing a new template within the same period does not create a duplicate; missed periods and prior evidence survive catch-up/retirement.
- [ ] Early/late/unknown-schedule work is not silently reassigned to the current period; later association requires auditable reconciliation.

**Dependencies:** [COL-137](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-137/hfo-03-implement-one-recurrence-and-due-date-evaluator), [COL-133](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-133/hfo-05-enforce-site-subject-and-current-person-authority-on-every)
**Related existing work:** See source pointers below
**Release:** Core. Implementation not started; this issue is not proof of deployment or staff acceptance.
**Source items:** Shared core contract across all applicable Admin Log items
**Source/code pointers:** `201_oce_reconciliation_and_generation_guard.sql:183, supabase/functions/oce-task-scheduler/index.ts:241, R01 R03`. Migration filenames are under `supabase/migrations/`; source paths are relative to Circle-of-Life unless explicitly named otherwise. Reconcile current main before editing.
**Open configuration questions:** Q05 See [Haven Facility Operations — Source Coverage and Open Decisions](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-source-coverage-and-open-decisions-0bf9ab4bebce).

**Build contract:** [Haven Facility Operations — Build Scope](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-build-scope-fa76df5ada21). **Sequence:** [Haven Facility Operations — Delivery Roadmap](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-delivery-roadmap-eab29aa94849).

One bounded implementation segment at a time. Record exact source/commit, focused behavioral tests, applicable repository segment gates, review and rollback/handoff evidence. Preserve current authority after waits and on retries, existing dirty/concurrent work, source truth and unknown rules. No new dependency, external transmission, clinical/employment decision or policy activation is implied. Keep source/local/hosted/provider/staff/operating-cycle acceptance distinct. No named assignee, estimate or date has been invented.
